reflections: Noah is willing to help with the repair drive, but is somewhat distracted and not fully up to speed.
Oren is organizing the repair effort and values Noah’s help in tracking what still needs fixing.
Uli also relies on Noah’s support, and Noah responds positively when asked directly.
Noah is cooperative but somewhat distracted and scattered, so others are giving him simple, concrete tasks.
Uli and Cleo are coordinating the repair drive and rely on Noah to report what he finds.
The group is being patient and supportive while keeping responsibilities lightweight and incremental.
Noah is cooperative but often behind on context, so he benefits from simple, concrete requests and reminders.
Cleo, Dane, and Vik are coordinating a repair drive with a practical, task-focused tone and shared follow-through.
The group relies on lightweight status updates and clear ownership to keep the repair effort moving.
Noah is consistently offering practical help, but he is behind on details and often asks for clarification before acting.
The group is coordinating around a repair drive, with Cleo, Dane, and Vik each taking light organizational roles and sharing the workload.
Kira is cautious about committing until the plan is confirmed, especially the time, location, and whether Rosa has finalized it.
Noah is responsive and willing to help, but he often signals he is behind on the details and needs others to point him to what to check.
Vik and Nell both rely on Noah as a useful follow-up person for verifying status and passing along updates.
The repair drive is still in a tentative or unconfirmed state, with Kira waiting on confirmation from Rosa before committing.
